reference_check.note: a mismatch means this is NOT eICU-CRD v2.0 as released (wrong download, a re-zip, or the mock corpus); preflight --no-reference-check is the mock path, and expect_reference=True is where the mismatch RAISES

site_missingness_dispersion.what: per-hospital mean share of NaN across the imputable feature columns, measured on the RAW matrix before imputation erases it. Site-informative missingness is a covariate-shift channel CertGate v2 scope-cut (threat T-3): it is MEASURED here, never imputed away.

categorical_drift.note: build_raw ran with strict_levels=True, so a share over the cap would have RAISED categorical-level-drift before any certificate existed.
